paragraphs.text: Pontotoc High School opens its wrestling season at home Thursday, Nov. 19, with Center Hill and New Albany on the schedule. The Warriors will see New Albany twice in their first two dates, with a return trip to New Albany on Tuesday, Dec. 1.

South Pontotoc and South Panola visit the Warriors on Thursday, Dec. 3. Two weeks later, on Dec. 17, Pontotoc travels to North Pontotoc for the Battle for the Belt. Those are the first dates on the Warriors’ schedule with the other two county programs.

Between the two county matchups, Pontotoc goes to Tupelo on Tuesday, Dec. 8. The Warriors also list the Oxford Challenge on Saturday, Dec. 12, as an individual event for boys. The school’s published schedule gives opponents and locations but leaves the opening-night start time unlisted.
